description: Enigma Code is a multidisciplinary team passionate about astronomy, planetary science, geology, AI, machine learning, advanced mathematics, and programming. We combine scientific research and computational innovation to analyze NASA datasets, discover Earth analogues of Mars and the Moon, and develop intelligent solutions for future planetary exploration.
summary: TerraScope: A mathematical data-driven method for analogue fidelity assessment of 12 Earth sites for lunar/martian equipment testing with a decision-support webapp. It dynamically ranks the sites for a mission’s tests using NASA’s orbit data. To combat the subjectivity of site selection today, TerraScope has developed the “Landing Hazard Index” and “Spectral Roughness” to ensure that engineers don’t pick a site that’s easy to drive, but impossible to land on. Most importantly, each result is automatically flagged with a “Analogue Gap” warning of terrestrial physical limitations. Urgent Testing Of Billion Dollar Equipment, Wrong Environment Must Be A Catastrophe. TerraScope has to be rigorous and falsifiable in its approach to site selection so that science and mission testing do not conflict with operational risk.
details:
Terrascope is a mathematical data-driven method for analogue fidelity assessment of 12 Earth sites for lunar/martian equipment testing with a decision-support web app. Apart from that, we also created an 8-bit pixel simulation for children and beginners to have more access to exploring projects in a more seamless way. In addition, we also have a challenge page for deeper research and discussion.

For the benefits that you can get from our project, we want every user to have the experience to explore and open up their mind about the exploration of space. We are also open for criticism from all generations as we learn together on this journey.

Our intended impact of this project is to simultaneously combine a professional and entertaining way to learn new experiences such as analog research.
